US Consortium, Including 49ers Enterprises, Acquires Majority Stake in Rangers FC

  • by Daniel Ruiz
  • 10th September 2025

A U.S.-based investment group, featuring San Francisco 49ers Enterprises, has purchased a majority stake in Scottish football club Rangers.

Rangers FC announced today that a consortium of U.S. based investors, working together with the investment arm of the San Francisco 49ers, has acquired a controlling position in the club. This is a historic moment for football club ownership, as it represents the globalisation of ownership, adding U.S. business experience focusing on sports and sports management, to one of Scotland's oldest teams. Analysts believe that the partnership could lead to new commercial opportunities and strategies, better opportunities to engage with fans, and new horizons for global engagement for Rangers amidst a rapidly growing trend of cross-border deals in sport.
